panels.title: Connection log in $namespace
panels.description: Every new connection Hubble saw (one policy verdict per enforcing endpoint, so pod-to-pod connections appear once as egress at the source and once as ingress at the destination). Destination shows the DNS name when the IP was resolved through Cilium's DNS proxy.

targets.expr:
{kubernetes.container_name="cilium-agent"} flow.verdict:* (flow.source.namespace:="$namespace" or flow.destination.namespace:="$namespace")
| format "<flow.IP.source>" as source
| format if (flow.source.identity:=1) "reserved:host" as source
| format if (flow.source.identity:=2) "reserved:world" as source
| format if (flow.source.identity:=4) "reserved:health" as source
| format if (flow.source.identity:=6) "reserved:remote-node" as source
| format if (flow.source.identity:=7) "reserved:kube-apiserver" as source
| format if (flow.source.identity:=8) "reserved:ingress" as source
| format if (flow.source.identity:=9) "reserved:world" as source
| format if (flow.source.pod_name:*) "<flow.source.namespace>/<flow.source.pod_name>" as source
| format "<flow.IP.destination>" as destination
| format if (flow.destination.identity:=1) "reserved:host" as destination
| format if (flow.destination.identity:=2) "reserved:world" as destination
| format if (flow.destination.identity:=4) "reserved:health" as destination
| format if (flow.destination.identity:=6) "reserved:remote-node" as destination
| format if (flow.destination.identity:=7) "reserved:kube-apiserver" as destination
| format if (flow.destination.identity:=8) "reserved:ingress" as destination
| format if (flow.destination.identity:=9) "reserved:world" as destination
| format if (flow.destination.pod_name:*) "<flow.destination.namespace>/<flow.destination.pod_name>" as destination
| format if (flow.destination_names:*) "<flow.destination_names>" as destination
| replace_regexp ("[\\[\\]\"]", "") at destination
| format "<flow.l4.TCP.destination_port><flow.l4.UDP.destination_port><flow.l4.SCTP.destination_port>" as port
| format if (flow.l4.TCP.destination_port:*) "TCP" as protocol
| format if (flow.l4.UDP.destination_port:*) "UDP" as protocol
| format if (flow.l4.ICMPv4.type:*) "ICMP" as protocol
| filter -source:~"^$exclude$"
| format "allowed" as verdict
| format if (flow.verdict:="DROPPED") "dropped" as verdict
| filter verdict:~"^($verdict)$"
| format "<flow.ingress_allowed_by><flow.egress_allowed_by><flow.ingress_denied_by><flow.egress_denied_by>" as policy_raw
| extract_regexp "\"name\":\"(?P<policy_name>[^\"]+)" from policy_raw
| extract_regexp "\"namespace\":\"(?P<policy_ns>[^\"]+)" from policy_raw
| extract_regexp "\"kind\":\"(?P<policy_kind>[^\"]+)" from policy_raw
| format "" as policy
| format if (policy_kind:="CiliumNetworkPolicy") "<policy_ns>/<policy_name>" as policy
| format if (policy_kind:="CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy") "<policy_name> (clusterwide)" as policy
| format if (policy_kind:="NetworkPolicy") "<policy_ns>/<policy_name> (k8s)" as policy
| format if (policy_raw:"allow-localhost-ingress") "allow-localhost (Cilium built-in)" as policy
| format if (verdict:="dropped" policy:="") "no policy allows this (default deny)" as policy
| stats by (source, destination, verdict, policy, flow.drop_reason_desc, port, protocol, flow.traffic_direction) count() as connections
| sort by (verdict desc, connections desc)

(sum by (source) (
  sum by (source, traffic_direction) (rate(hubble_flows_processed_total{type="PolicyVerdict", traffic_direction="ingress", destination_namespace="$namespace", verdict!="DROPPED", source!~"$exclude", destination!~"$exclude"}[$__rate_interval]))
  or sum by (source, traffic_direction) (rate(hubble_flows_processed_total{type="PolicyVerdict", traffic_direction="ingress", source_namespace="$namespace", destination_namespace!="$namespace", verdict!="DROPPED", source!~"$exclude", destination!~"$exclude"}[$__rate_interval]))
  or sum by (source, traffic_direction) (rate(hubble_flows_processed_total{type="PolicyVerdict", traffic_direction="egress", source_namespace="$namespace", destination_namespace="", verdict!="DROPPED", source!~"$exclude", destination!~"$exclude"}[$__rate_interval]))
) > 0)

(sum by (destination) (
  sum by (destination, traffic_direction) (rate(hubble_flows_processed_total{type="PolicyVerdict", traffic_direction="ingress", destination_namespace="$namespace", verdict!="DROPPED", source!~"$exclude", destination!~"$exclude"}[$__rate_interval]))
  or sum by (destination, traffic_direction) (rate(hubble_flows_processed_total{type="PolicyVerdict", traffic_direction="ingress", source_namespace="$namespace", destination_namespace!="$namespace", verdict!="DROPPED", source!~"$exclude", destination!~"$exclude"}[$__rate_interval]))
  or sum by (destination, traffic_direction) (rate(hubble_flows_processed_total{type="PolicyVerdict", traffic_direction="egress", source_namespace="$namespace", destination_namespace="", verdict!="DROPPED", source!~"$exclude", destination!~"$exclude"}[$__rate_interval]))
) > 0)

(sum by (source, destination) (
  sum by (source, destination, traffic_direction) (rate(hubble_flows_processed_total{type="PolicyVerdict", traffic_direction="ingress", destination_namespace="$namespace", verdict="DROPPED", source!~"$exclude", destination!~"$exclude"}[$__rate_interval]))
  or sum by (source, destination, traffic_direction) (rate(hubble_flows_processed_total{type="PolicyVerdict", traffic_direction="ingress", source_namespace="$namespace", destination_namespace!="$namespace", verdict="DROPPED", source!~"$exclude", destination!~"$exclude"}[$__rate_interval]))
  or sum by (source, destination, traffic_direction) (rate(hubble_flows_processed_total{type="PolicyVerdict", traffic_direction="egress", source_namespace="$namespace", verdict="DROPPED", source!~"$exclude", destination!~"$exclude"}[$__rate_interval]))
) > 0)
